hooks.name: core-tests-on-save
hooks.description: When a Rust file under crates/limina-core/src or crates/limina-core/tests is saved, runs cargo fmt --all --check, cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings and cargo test --workspace from the repository root, with %USERPROFILE%\.cargo\bin added to PATH inside the command. Reports PASS or FAIL in two lines. Never modifies files.

action.command: cmd /d /v:on /c "set PATH=%USERPROFILE%\.cargo\bin;%PATH%& set F=ok& set C=ok& set T=ok& (cargo fmt --all --check >nul 2>&1 || set F=FAIL)& (cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings >nul 2>&1 || set C=FAIL)& (cargo test --workspace >nul 2>&1 || set T=FAIL)& (if !F!!C!!T!==okokok (echo core-tests-on-save: PASS) else (echo core-tests-on-save: FAIL))& echo fmt=!F! clippy=!C! test=!T!"
